Exclusive Weddings

Properties up to 60 bedrooms

Your wedding is a once-in-a-lifetime milestone. It is your opportunity to bring together those you cherish most in a venue worthy of your love story, celebrating with an Arabian Nights evening that everyone will cherish. Whether you require accommodations for 60 guests or a more intimate private riad, we provide the tailor-made estate.

Why Choose Us?

Because with us, you have a single dedicated contact person and we take care of everything. We offer multiple luxury properties in Marrakech, ranging from 5 to 60 bedrooms, and handpick the ideal exclusive venue for your celebration. Our experienced on-site team is personally supervised by Nadia, your dedicated event coordinator, acting as your seamless liaison throughout your stay.

What We Provide

Multiple private estates at your disposal: luxury villas, authentic riads, and boutique guesthouses from 5 to 60 bedrooms
A dedicated on-site professional team, led by Nadia, your primary event planner
Airport meet-and-greet with our trusted premium transport partners
Authentic Moroccan cuisine and oriental gourmet tastings crafted by our private in-house chefs
Special dietary requirements and allergies accommodated: please specify them in your request
Lively evening entertainment: live DJs, fire-eaters, and traditional folklore performers for vibrant nights
Signature Marrakech excursions: Agafay desert dinners, quad biking, and 4x4 Atlas mountain expeditions
